name: Ciao Lucia
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $270 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Silk and cotton dresses, tops, skirts and knits (dresses around $350–$550), sold through its website, own stores, department stores and boutiques.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles, United States in 2017 by Lucy Akin.

ownership.owner: Lucy Blair LLC (dba Ciao Lucia; operating company per site privacy policy; shareholders not published)

quote.q: I started embodying this girl—Lucia—who was carefree and independent.

opview: “I started embodying this girl—Lucia—who was carefree and independent.” — Lucy Akin, founder and designer, goop

facts_read.source: brand site; goop 2022; Nylon 2025; Vinted catalogue page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: Nav link 'Venice Store' -> one own store. Separate Stockists page lists online retailers + many US boutiques (third-party, not counted).

craft_evidence.reasoning: Older styles say Made in Los Angeles or Peru, but current-season pages give no country, and the store has no page about the brand or its making. Nothing to credit beyond a quarter of pages naming a place: 1.
